newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean Jan-Oct inflation rises 5.8 percent.
newsitem.headline: Chilean Jan-Oct inflation rises 5.8 percent.

text.p: Chilean consumer prices rose 5.8 percent in the first ten months of the year, against seven percent in the same period 1995, said the National Statistics Institute.
The institute reported inflation slowing slightly to 0.7 percent last month from 0.8 percent in October last year.
October's figure brought the rise in inflation in the last 12 months to 6.2 percent compared with 8.8 percent in the year to October 1995.
Prices which rose in October included food, up 0.5 percent, housing, up 0.9 percent, clothing, up 1.2 percent and transport and communications costs which increased 1.4 percent.
